info.prompt: Cyber-gothic arena where skeletal ribcage arches drip neon cyan data onto a grid of translucent bone tiles—every fifth turn triggers a gravity flip with directional arrows flashing UP before dice slide along new trajectories in 400ms physics snaps, while a hidden pocket slot pulses "Hidden: 5" beside tri-color racing indicators (red PRESSURE/green SLIPSTREAM/blue CRUISE) that update live with 75ms-150ms beat windows.
